title: Fix incorrect audio timestamps for lyrics lines
description: Some lyrics lines have incorrect startTime/endTime values causing playback issues. Examples: 'برای نخبه های زندانی' (For the imprisoned intellectuals) plays both its snippet AND the next line's snippet. 'برای کودکان افغانی' (For the Afghan children) barely plays anything - timestamp range too short. Need to audit and fix timestamp accuracy in the lyrics data.
